item.title: Murmurly 1.11.0
item.description:
Murmur is now Murmurly

Same app, new name. This release is a fresh install rather than an update: if you have Murmur 1.10, download Murmurly from murmurly.prayasmittal.com and drag it to Applications. The updater inside 1.10 can't install it, and macOS will ask for the microphone, speech and Accessibility permissions again. Your history and statistics carry over.

An account

Murmurly asks you to sign in with Google the first time it opens. The account is how Murmurly knows it's you, and what it sends home afterwards is counts — how many dictations, how many words, which features — never a word of what you said. Audio and transcription still never leave your Mac. Sign in once; after that it works offline.

One window

History, Insights, Dictionary, Snippets, AI and Settings are pages of a single window with a sidebar. The Dictation page shows the words as they arrive while you hold the key, then the transcripts by day.

Fixes

  • The first-run guide no longer reappears when every permission is already granted.
  • Signing out closes every window and discards any dictation in progress.
